title: feat(plugin-detail): record:related_list reads showViewAll, and "View all" opens the parent-scoped list (objectui#12741)
body:
Fixes #12741
Clause-②: yes

`record:related_list` reads `showViewAll`, and its "View all" link opens the related object's records filtered to this parent. This is ENFORCE, the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23941. The verdict carries over from the maintainer's ruling 5902374623 on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20665, with #11263 as the precedent.

Clause-② is yes because `@object-ui/react`'s exported `RelatedRecordHandlers` gains one optional member, `onViewAll`. No input, spec key or accept set changes. The claim anticipated this flip.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/react`**: `RelatedRecordHandlers.onViewAll?: () => void`. The host returns it from `resolve` to open the child object's list page, scoped to the parent on the relationship it was handed. As with every handler on this interface, omitting it hides the affordance.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` resolves `onViewAll` to the ADR-0055 bare data surface, `/apps/APP/OBJECT/data?filter[REL]=PARENT`. `recordListPath` is extracted from `useOpenRecordList`, so the dashboard drill and View all spell this route in one place. The link is withheld where the route cannot show "this parent's children":
  - when the list has no relationship or no parent value;
  - for a `multiple: true` relationship, because the URL grammar has no membership operator (the reason `RelatedList`'s raw-URL fetch refuses it);
  - for a relationship field the viewer cannot read, because `ObjectDataPage` drops that condition and would open the whole table.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail`**:
  - The renderer passes `onViewAll` unless `showViewAll === false`. When the key is absent, the spec default `true` applies.
  - `RelatedList` draws the link whenever it has `onViewAll` and records. The old gate drew it only when records ran past one page, and the spec states no such condition. This renderer is the only caller that passes `onViewAll`.

## Measured before building (the card's premise)

- H1 confirmed: at main 236624d, the renderer read neither `showViewAll` nor `onViewAll`.
- H2 confirmed: the route exists. AppContent.tsx registers `:objectName/data` for ObjectDataPage, which parses `filter[FIELD]=VALUE` and shows each condition as a chip. `useOpenRecordList` already navigates there. No page or URL spelling was invented.
- H3: the truncation-only gate was dropped (above).
- H4: no booking. The parity file's `MEMBER_PINS` holds member shapes of array/object inputs only, and a test asserts every pin names one. A boolean has no slot, and the file passes unchanged.
- H5, measured live: the seeded admin's sys_user record page, Positions tab. The platform page authors `showViewAll: true` with `limit: 25` and 4 rows.

## Live reading

Setup: a published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2` backend (e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh, showcase e5136ff10f1a) and the console dev server from each tree. PNGs are on branch `claude/issue-12741-evidence` under `evidence/12741/`:

- `before-sys-user-positions.png` (base 236624d): no "View all" on any of the 10 tabs.
- `after-sys-user-positions.png`: "View all" under the 4 rows.
- `after-view-all-target.png`: the click lands on `/apps/setup/sys_user_position/data?filter[user_id]=ADMIN_ID`, which shows 4 records and the chip "User = ADMIN_ID".

## Tests

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordRelatedListRenderer.showViewAll-12741.test.tsx`: through the real SchemaRenderer, registration, RelatedList and data table.
  - Absent: the link draws with every row fitting, and calls the host.
  - `true`: the link draws.
  - `false`: no link (control: the header's New is drawn).
  - Empty list: no link.
  - A host with no destination, or no host: no link.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RelatedRecordActionsBridge.viewAll-12741.test.tsx`: through the real bridge under a router.
  - The click goes to `/apps/demo/task/data`, and the search reads back via `parseUrlFilterTriples` as exactly `[project, =, P-1]`.
  - `false`, a multi-value relationship and an unreadable relationship field each draw no link.
  - Control: a denied field the relationship does not use keeps the link.
- Ablations: each went red on the expected rows (2, 4, 4, 1, 1 and 1 failing tests), and the tree was restored to the HEAD blob each time.
  - ignoring `false`;
  - not passing `onViewAll`;
  - restoring the truncation gate;
  - dropping the multi-value guard;
  - dropping the FLS guard;
  - pointing at the object route.
- Two existing bridge test doubles (createPredicates, effectiveOps) mocked `usePermissions` without the required `checkField`. They gain an open one.
- Results:
  - Families at d040dd8: plugin-detail whole plus 141 grep hits, 420 passed and 1 failed. The failure was the doubles above, fixed in 85decad.
  - After merging main at f439fc1: 69 files and 1025 tests passed.

## Gates

At f439fc1 the following exit 0:

- check:changeset-claims, changeset:check, check:test-path-roots, check:spec-symbols, check:new-line-citations and check-changeset-presence;
- type-check of react, plugin-detail, app-shell and console, after their closure builds;
- eslint on the changed files: 0 errors, and no warning on an added line.

The i18n family is not owed: no `t()` call or rendered string changed.

## Acceptance notes

- The related list's own authored `filter` is not carried to the full list. View all opens all records related to this parent, as the spec's describe says.
- ObjectView.tsx's comment on its `filter[FIELD]` equality arm says it is used by related-list View all buttons. That was never wired, and View all now goes to `/data`. This is comment drift only, so nothing is filed.
- Behaviour change: on a console record page, every related list with records now shows "View all", unless it declares `showViewAll: false`.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#23941's ledger row moves once this is installable at `.objectui-sha`. No objectstack PR is owed, because the key stays as declared.

Before opening, the seat asked for one doc-only commit, `043c3b0`: `recordListPath` moved above `useOpenRecordList`'s docblock so each docblock sits on its own function (a pure move, 27/27 lines; app-shell type-check and 18 files / 101 tests green at that head). The seat replaced the dev's footer lines with this paragraph and changed nothing else.
